name: Rowing
notes: Ergometer or on-water rowing tracked by distance and elapsed time.

guide.setup: Set the foot straps securely and sit tall with relaxed shoulders and shins near vertical at the catch.
guide.execution: Drive with the legs first, swing the torso back, then draw the handle to the lower ribs. Reverse the sequence smoothly.
guide.cues: Legs, body, arms. Arms, body, legs. Keep the chain level.
guide.mistakes: Pulling with the arms first; rounding at the catch; rushing recovery; shrugging the shoulders.
